rules.name: cash-refresh-07-missing-fx-ndf-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT trade_id,client_code,contract_number,derivative_type,product_code,currency, value_date,settlement_date,transaction_date,maturity_date,netting_status,netting_date, is_premium_paid,original_lots,active_lots,original_premium,mult_factor,nc_factor,fx_nc_factor, settle_price,CASE WHEN settle_price IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'VALUE' END AS settle_price_state, (settle_price-original_premium)*active_lots*mult_factor*-1 AS matlab_m2m_nc, (settle_price-original_premium)*active_lots*mult_factor*-1*nc_factor*fx_nc_factor AS matlab_m2m_usd FROM dbsystemuat.helper_cash_balance_report_view_cfs WHERE value_date=:valueDate AND settlement_date=:cob AND upper(trim(client_code)) IN ('OCF','OGB') AND upper(trim(derivative_type))='FX_FORWARD_NDF' AND upper(trim(product_code))='USDBRL' ORDER BY client_code,trade_id

SELECT trade_id,client_code,contract_number,derivative_type,product_code,currency, value_date,settlement_date,transaction_date,maturity_date,netting_status,netting_date, is_premium_paid,original_lots,active_lots,original_premium,mult_factor,nc_factor,fx_nc_factor, settle_price,CASE WHEN settle_price IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'VALUE' END AS settle_price_state, (settle_price-original_premium)*active_lots*mult_factor*-1 AS matlab_m2m_nc, (settle_price-original_premium)*active_lots*mult_factor*-1*nc_factor*fx_nc_factor AS matlab_m2m_usd FROM opera_backup_04_10.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(:tenant,'CFS') WHERE value_date=:valueDate AND settlement_date=:cob AND upper(trim(client_code)) IN ('OCF','OGB') AND upper(trim(derivative_type))='FX_FORWARD_NDF' AND upper(trim(product_code))='USDBRL' ORDER BY client_code,trade_id

SELECT trade_id,client_code,contract_number,derivative_type,product_code,currency, value_date,settlement_date,transaction_date,maturity_date,netting_status,netting_date, is_premium_paid,original_lots,active_lots,original_premium,mult_factor,nc_factor,fx_nc_factor, settle_price,CASE WHEN settle_price IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'VALUE' END AS settle_price_state, (settle_price-original_premium)*active_lots*mult_factor*-1 AS matlab_m2m_nc, (settle_price-original_premium)*active_lots*mult_factor*-1*nc_factor*fx_nc_factor AS matlab_m2m_usd FROM opera.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(:tenant,'CFS') WHERE value_date=:valueDate AND settlement_date=:cob AND upper(trim(client_code)) IN ('OCF','OGB') AND upper(trim(derivative_type))='FX_FORWARD_NDF' AND upper(trim(product_code))='USDBRL' ORDER BY client_code,trade_id
